name: valid
yaml:
apiVersion: sybil/v1alpha1
kind: Environment
metadata:
  name: staging
spec:
  integration: lab
  group: web
  variables:
    size: 2048
  networks:
    - name: appnet
      zone: lab
      subnet: 10.20.0.0/24
      gateway: 10.20.0.1
      snat: true
      dhcp: false
  resources:
    - name: web
      count: 2
      blueprint: provision-vm
      network: appnet
      inputs:
        hostname: web-{{instance.number}}
        memory_mb: '{{var.size}}'
